scenario: One Arrow Right icon; React is external for component cases

strategies.label: Named component
strategies.consequence: Best component tree-shaking: only the selected definition and shared React adapter remain.

strategies.label: Dynamic component
strategies.consequence: Runtime name selection retains the complete definition catalog.

strategies.label: Category lookup
strategies.consequence: Runtime category traversal retains the complete catalog even when one group is selected.

strategies.label: Raw SVG asset
strategies.consequence: Ships one authored asset and no framework adapter; behavior and accessibility are consumer-owned.
